name: Ashetella
aboutMe:
Hello! I am an undergraduate student majoring in HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning) at TJU (Tongji University). I am passionate about building energy efficiency, indoor environmental quality, and sustainable engineering solutions.

Through my studies, I have gained a solid foundation in thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and system design. I enjoy applying theoretical knowledge to practical projects, such as optimizing HVAC systems for comfort and energy savings.

I am eager to explore innovative technologies in the field and contribute to creating healthier, more sustainable indoor environments.
